title: Qubi's Everything
description: A Heavy-weight Modpack that adds stuff tailored to me, and only me. VR support.
body:
**WARNING. THIS MODPACK SUCKS.**
This modpack is made for me, and only me. I'm just trying to share things i find cool and slowly turn it into something playable.

## **FEATURES:**
- Over 250 mods 
- Too many biomes/structures
- Over 12000 items/block (thanks, Chipped)
- VR support
- Unoptimized (for now)
- Planes
- Pine Boat with Cannon
- Some mods rebalanced to fit my preferences
